prompt:
Top-down black-and-white editorial still photograph, high contrast, fine film grain. A single sheet of matte white paper lies flat on a seamless charcoal black paper backdrop, slightly rotated. Hard sunlight from the upper left casts a crisp, deep diagonal window shadow across part of the frame.
The sheet is a monthly lab worksheet, the first page of a monthly issue for subscribers. It shows only the artifact's own content, never a caption or description of what it is, printed in clean modern sans-serif typography, near-black ink, generous margins and a clear hierarchy. Visible text, spelled exactly: "November lab"; "Build your own AI benchmark"; "Worksheet · prompts · project". One small solid black printed block behind the label "November lab", its text knocked out in white.
Nothing else in the frame: no hands, no people, no desk, no pens, no plants, no devices, no props, no logos. Monochrome only, gallery-quality print photography.
